reviews.text:
Answered Prayers Needs More Functionality. I like the app so far but I’m providing this review primarily as a developer recommendation. The app allows you to add notes for a prayer which is good. But then it gives you the additional option to mark the prayer as answered. However, that feature basically acts like marking an item off of a list. It drops off of your prayer list and goes into the “answered” bucket. I’ll recommend a different/additional approach.

There are many prayers we want to be reminded of on a regular basis. For instance, a friend’s cancer treatment. Or just regularly, daily prayers such as for “diligence at work” or “opportunities to share my faith.” There may be numerous, discrete answers to an ongoing prayer over time. It would be nice to be able to show they’ve been answered without removing the “Frank’s cancer” or “diligence at work” prayer from your rotation. It would also be nice to have a specific option to write notes about how a prayer is answered each individual time and have that logged and nested within the overall prayer. Those notes could also show up in the “answered” menu without having to remove the prayer item from your overall ongoing prayer list.

reviews.text:
God used this app to change my life. I am not an app person. I have never reviewed an app before, but I need to boast in the Holy Spirit and the life-changing power of prayer. I spent a decade sporadically praying, struggling with not having the desire to prayer, and often avoiding it. A year ago today, I committed to praying every day, no excuses, and to call on the Holy Spirit, aligning my prayers with scripture. I had tried to desire prayer before, to be more Christ-like, I thought I just needed to work harder at it, but of my effort alone, I was hopeless to change. 

I began using this app every day, asking the Holy Spirit to give me a heart that desires what it should, to desire Him, to desire prayer. I was praying for 10 minutes a day, than 20, 40, 60, at times immersed so deeply in prayer, that I could look up and in disbelief, see that over an hour had passed by. Instead of finding all the excuses not to pray, I could no longer find a single excuse of why I wouldn’t pray. 

This app allowed me to actually remember what I wanted to prayer for, to pray consistently, and through it my prayers multiplied. Echo became the app I opened first in the morning, and throughout the day. I learned to pray in line at the grocery store, in waiting rooms, in stirring a pot on the stove, washing dishes, folding laundry. I began to understand how someone could prayer without ceasing. 

365 days, and 16,185 minutes of prayer later, I can hardly recognize who I was a year ago. I used to be distracted from prayer by my phone, but with Echo my phone became a tool for, and not against, prayer. Prayer transforms the heart, and if the Holy Spirit can do it in me, he can do it in you. Put God first, and everything else with fall into its rightful place beneath Him. Prayer will equip you for what you face in each day.
